body:
# MarlToch Totem (3D Cosmetic)

Tired of the same old boring Totem of Undying? Swap it out for a highly detailed, custom 3D model pack of MarlToch! 

**I highly recommend using the Punchy mod alongside this pack! It lets you customize your first-person viewmodels, meaning you can change the exact position and angle of the pack in your hand so it fits perfectly on your screen without blocking your view.**
https://modrinth.com/project/8aoMKplv

### Built Entirely on Mobile!
i use blockbench in the making of this texture pack not gonna lie i don't know none editing this kinds of stuff especially using a phone but in the end making a texture pack is easy you just need to have fun while making it hehehehe. 

### Version & Compatibility
* **Format:** Built on version 1.9.1.
* **Tested & Working:** Runs perfectly fine on version 1.21.11 (Mounth Mayhem pack). It features excellent backwards and forward compatibility for modern versions without breaking animations or textures.

### Disclaimer
**Cosmetic Only:** This texture pack is strictly for cosmetic and aesthetic purposes for players who want a unique parody look for their totems.

**Health Warning:** Smoking is harmful to your health. This pack is a parody creation and does not promote or endorse smoking in any way.
